Part II. Listen to a conversation between Nam and Mai. Choose the best answer A, B, C or D. You will hear the recording twice.
Mai: Hi, Nam. What are you doing?
Nam: I am decorating my bedroom.
Mai: Your room looks nice. Where is your bed?
Nam: It is next to the window.
Mai: Is there anything on the wall?
Nam: Yes. There is a clock on the wall, but I need more light.
Mai: How about buying a new lamp?
Nam: Great idea.
Mai: Let’s go to the department store this afternoon.
Nam: OK.
Now listen again

Mai: Hi, Nam. What are you doing?
Nam: I am decorating my bedroom.
Mai: Your room looks nice. Where is your bed?
Nam: It is next to the window.
Mai: Is there anything on the wall?
Nam: Yes. There is a clock on the wall, but I need more light.
Mai: How about buying a new lamp?
Nam: Great idea.
Mai: Let’s go to the department store this afternoon.
Nam: OK.
